svg.title: A route through the research chapters
svg.desc: Chapters 10–15 and 18–19 follow the research from its question to handoff. Evidence and data can revise the question; checks and writing return to analysis. Chapters 16–17 provide an additional route when LLM outputs become research data.
svg.text: When the research uses LLM outputs
Ch 16 · Use LLM outputs as research data
Ch 17 · Run and adapt LLMs for your research
Approve scientific revisions and record their reasons
